mapper.insert: insert into "chat_record" ( record_id, room_id, user_id, description, image_addr, able_withdraw_time) values( #{recordId}, #{roomId}, #{userId}, #{description}, #{imageAddr}, #{ableWithdrawTime})
mapper.select: select record_id, room_id, user_id, description, image_addr, able_withdraw_time, create_time, is_withdraw from "chat_record" where (select exists ( select 1 from chat_room where room_id=#{roomId} and able_chat=true and (first_user_id=#{userId} or second_user_id=#{userId})) )=true and is_withdraw=false order by record_id desc limit #{need} offset #{start}
mapper.update: update "chat_record" set is_withdraw=true where record_id=#{recordId} and user_id=#{userId} and is_withdraw=false and now() < able_withdraw_time
